name: two-track-check
description: Static checker for applications built on two-track: finds the anti-FP foot-guns the type checker cannot see, with the fix in every message.
author: Mike Zupper

scripts.selfcheck: node bin/two-track-check.mjs test/fixtures/compliant && node bin/two-track-check.mjs --project tsconfig.self.json .
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && pnpm selfcheck
